record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Six units declare SPIKY_SHIELD: Silcoon, Cascoon, Chespin, Maractus (see appliesTo for stars), Quilladin and Chesnaught. The strategy is shared; unit differences are star count (table index), range and maxPP; none of the six declares a passive.
record.summary: The caster deals SPECIAL damage equal to round(multiplier x its own DEF) to the cast target (multiplier 0.6/0.8/1/2 by stars). If the caster already had spike armor when it cast, it also deals flat SPECIAL damage (30/30/30/60 by stars) to every enemy-team unit on the rays in all 8 directions out to the board edge. Afterwards it gains (or refreshes to the longer of old and new) spike armor for 3000/5000/10000/10000 ms. While spike armor is active, any unit that hits the caster from distance 1 (without PROTECTIVE_PADS) is wounded for 2000 ms and takes retaliation SPECIAL damage from the caster's DEF.

targeting.who: damage: the cast target (DEF-based) and, only if spike armor was already active at cast time, every enemy-team unit on the 8 rays from the caster; buff: the caster
targeting.note: The rays are unbounded in length (no maxRange) and not blocked by units. The cast target also receives ray damage if it lies on a ray, in addition to the DEF-based hit.

geometry.shape: single target + 8 straight rays (orthogonal and diagonal) from the caster's cell to the board edge, conditional on pre-existing spike armor

effects.scaling: base is the caster's current DEF, not a fixed number; then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: then the target's SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce

effects.target: every enemy-team unit on the 8 rays, only if spike armor was already active at cast time
effects.scaling: AP: x (1 + AP/100); crit as above; each unit is hit once per ray that crosses it
effects.resolution: then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; per-target protect / skydiving / magicBounce block
cooldown = max(current, new); while active, melee-range hitters take retaliation damage (separate effect below)

effects.target: a unit that hits the spike-armored caster from distance 1 (no PROTECTIVE_PADS)
effects.scaling: round(caster DEF x factor x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if the retaliation rolled a crit)
effects.resolution: applied through handleDamage with isRetaliation true (not read further); the wound is applied to the attacker

statusEffects.effect: applied to a retaliating-hit attacker (effect of wound not read)

starBehavior.note: all tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star column is not reachable by the bare factory star counts (the retaliation table has no 4th entry and uses 1 as fallback). Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: Ray damage requires spike armor to be active at the moment of casting (a repeat cast within the duration). Ray length is the distance to the board edge; the RIGHT ray is bounded by board.rows instead of board.columns in the source as written. Retaliation needs the attacker at distance exactly 1.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Two modes by pre-existing spikeArmor: first cast (no armor) = target hit + armor; a cast while armor is active = target hit + 8 rays + refreshed armor (the longer cooldown is kept). The animation flag also depends on the pre-cast state.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: target hit = DEF multiplier (0.6/0.8/1 for 1/2/3 stars) x the caster's DEF at cast time; ray hit 30 (1-3 stars); armor 3000/5000/10000 ms; retaliation DEF factor 0.6/0.8/1. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) (x critPower on a crit), then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers.
